_comment: One place that says how much capital each bot is sized against. Set 2026-11-13: the account total is $1,500 and every bot that still runs is sized against the whole account, as if it traded alone (they are alert and paper bots, not a funded book, so the script's overcommit warning is expected). scripts/set_fleet_capital.py refuses to run while any value is null and never invents one. 'variables' are the GitHub repo Variable names the workflows read; 'workflows' are the files that read them. Edit the numbers, then: python scripts/set_fleet_capital.py (dry run) and --apply. Retired or archived bots (Apex-Sniper, Apex_Omega, spy-bps-bot, Daily-Stock-Options-Alert, Tier1-Bot, daytrading_bot condor) were removed from this table on 2026-11-13; their workflows keep their own defaults.

bots.note: At $1,500 the sleeve's 5% per-position cap sizes to 0 contracts; it alerts NO ENTRY until the account is near $20,000.
